O sobrenome é necessário porque 氏 só existe preso a um nome. Usa 言う e そう, ambos no cumulative_known_set de les:n3-concessao-04; sem 。 final. O alvo continua 2 abaixo do limiar.

I checked this jp through Sudachi C-mode and bare 具体 is emitted as its own noun token (グタイ), so unlike the other two zero-candidate targets in this batch, generation genuinely closes this gap. Caveat for the reviewer: bare 具体 is business/abstract register in real Japanese, so this is a defensible sentence but not a lively one.

rows.jp: この橋は長大だ

rows.pt: Esta ponte é imensa.
rows.pt_literal: Quanto a esta ponte (は = tema), (é) longa e grande.
rows.why: GENERATED. This target is listed with 8 candidates but has zero REAL ones: all 8 match on the kana form ちょうだい, which in every one of those sentences is 頂戴 ('give me'), not 長大 ('enormous'). The vocab-form map wrongly assigns ちょうだい to this record, so selecting any of them would have the corpus assert that 飴ちょうだい exemplifies 'enorme'. Written instead with the kanji form 長大, which is this record's primary form and does resolve here. Uses only les:n3-conectores-06's cumulative_known_set (この vocab:1582920, 橋 vocab:1237410) plus the target; final 。 dropped.
